title: Merging tick 9sz will break the build: internal/cli gets a second TestMain
description:
9sz's branch adds internal/cli/run_test.go, whose TestMain doubles the test binary as the detached `ticfac run` child (dispatching on os.Args[1] == "run-epic"). epic/2jn now carries this tick's internal/cli/main_test.go TestMain (registrytest.GuardMain). Two TestMains in one package cannot compile, so the 9sz merge will fail go build/vet until a single TestMain does both: dispatch the detached child first, then registrytest.GuardMain(m). Predicted, not yet demonstrable — 9sz is unmerged and I could not build that union here.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 33a9290dfc0daed1ca806d785cec349f1028a4d2bec512ef4913e914863c0826 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-7ag/attempt-23): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/33a9290dfc0daed1ca806d785cec349f1028a4d2bec512ef4913e914863c0826.json on the run branch.
